sources.title: Loup River Water Trail
sources.publisher: Nebraskaland Magazine / Nebraska Game and Parks Commission
sources.supports: Confirms that an existing fishing access on George D. Syas WMA is used as the upstream trail starting point; distinguishes it from the newly built Monroe access. Provides no launch coordinate or exact parking/carry location.

sources.title: Float your boat – Community collaboration powers Loup River Water Trail creation
sources.supports: Confirms the WMA fishing access and describes directions to the Monroe access. The directions do not locate the WMA launch.

sources.title: Water Trails
sources.supports: Current official source for Nebraska water-trail planners and access maps.

sources.title: Loup River Water Trail guide
sources.supports: Official trip planner gives a coordinate for the Monroe-to-Columbus segment and identifies the Syas WMA fishing access as an upstream point, but does not give a coordinate for that access.

sources.title: 2026-27 Public Access Atlas, site index
sources.supports: Confirms George D. Syas WMA as a public-access property and provides its map-sheet reference; the reviewed index does not publish a launch coordinate.

sources.title: 2026-27 Public Access Atlas, map sheet 36 NE
sources.supports: Locates George D. Syas WMA on the current atlas map but does not label or publish a specific river-entry feature coordinate.

sources.title: NGPC Water Trails interactive map
sources.supports: Official map page linked from NGPC's Water Trails planning page. Its web-map configuration identifies the Paddle Craft Access - Paddlecraft Launch operational feature layer.

sources.title: Paddlecraft Launch feature, George D. Syas WMA (OBJECTID 97)

attributes.SiteNotes: Long walking path to get to launch site.

sources.supports: Official water-entry feature for the named WMA. Coordinate comes from the feature's latitude/longitude fields, not the WMA polygon or a map viewport. Treat 100 ft as coordinate uncertainty and verify the long walking path and current status on site.

sources.title: Public Access Boat Ramps
sources.supports: NGPC staff describe this as a reference inventory of public boat ramps, updated April 28, 2026, and explicitly state that it is not comprehensive.

sources.title: Public Access Boat Ramps feature service, layer 0
sources.result: No matching feature returned. This official dataset was updated April 28, 2026 but explicitly says its inventory is not comprehensive; absence is corroborative only and does not establish that no fishing access exists.
sources.supports: A current exact-name query found no published boat-ramp feature or point for Syas WMA.

sources.title: Local official map-control record
sources.supports: Records the stored coordinate as the WMA polygon's representative/label point and explicitly excludes interpreting it as a launch, parking, or water-entry coordinate.
